```{r}
#Helper functions for calculation

#Monthly Anomalies
calc_anomalies <- function(M, months) {
  anom <- M
  for (m in 1:12) {
    idx  <- which(months == m)
    clim <- rowMeans(M[, idx, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    clim[is.nan(clim)] <- NA
    anom[, idx] <- M[, idx, drop = FALSE] - clim   # clim recycles down columns
  }
  anom
}

#Centered running mean along time
roll_time <- function(A, k = 3, min_periods = 1) {
  stopifnot(k %% 2 == 1)
  half <- (k - 1) / 2
  nt <- ncol(A)
  S <- matrix(0, nrow(A), nt)
  N <- matrix(0, nrow(A), nt)
  for (o in -half:half) {
    src <- seq_len(nt) + o
    ok  <- src >= 1 & src <= nt
    X <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(A), nt)
    X[, ok] <- A[, src[ok], drop = FALSE]
    v <- !is.na(X)
    X[!v] <- 0
    S <- S + X
    N <- N + v
  }
  out <- S / N
  out[N < min_periods] <- NA
  out
}

#Remove linear trend (and mean) along time per cell
detrend_dim <- function(M) {
  tt <- seq_len(ncol(M))
  res <- apply(M, 1, function(y) {
    ok <- !is.na(y)
    if (sum(ok) < 2) return(y)
    fit <- lm.fit(cbind(1, tt[ok]), y[ok])$coefficients
    y - (fit[1] + fit[2] * tt)
  })
  t(res)
}

#Regress a field onto a 1D PC
regress_spatial <- function(pc, pc_time, A, A_time) {
  pc_n <- as.numeric(pc_time)
  A_n  <- as.numeric(A_time)
  common <- sort(intersect(pc_n, A_n))
 
  pcc <- pc[match(common, pc_n)]
  Ac  <- A[, match(common, A_n), drop = FALSE]
 
  pc_anom <- pcc - mean(pcc)
  Ad  <- Ac - rowMeans(Ac, na.rm = TRUE)
  cov <- rowMeans(Ad * rep(pc_anom, each = nrow(Ac)), na.rm = TRUE)
  v   <- mean(pc_anom^2)
  out <- cov / v
  out[is.nan(out)] <- NA
  out
}

#3x3 spatial running mean on a lat/long matrix
roll_2d <- function(Fm, min_n = 4) {
  nx <- nrow(Fm); ny <- ncol(Fm)
  S <- matrix(0, nx, ny); N <- matrix(0, nx, ny)
  for (dx in -1:1) for (dy in -1:1) {
    xs <- seq_len(nx) + dx; ys <- seq_len(ny) + dy
    okx <- xs >= 1 & xs <= nx
    oky <- ys >= 1 & ys <= ny
    X <- matrix(NA_real_, nx, ny)
    X[okx, oky] <- Fm[xs[okx], ys[oky]]
    v <- !is.na(X)
    X[!v] <- 0
    S <- S + X
    N <- N + v
  }
  out <- S / N
  out[N < min_n] <- NA
  out
}

#Convert a netCDF time axis to Date
nc_time_to_date <- function(nc, varname = "time") {
  tv    <- ncvar_get(nc, varname)
  units <- ncatt_get(nc, varname, "units")$value
  origin <- as.Date(sub(".*since\\s+([0-9]+-[0-9]+-[0-9]+).*", "\\1", units))
  if (grepl("^days", units)) {
    origin + tv
  } else if (grepl("^hours", units)) {
    origin + tv / 24
  } else {
    stop("Unhandled time units: ", units)
  }
}

# Download with auto-resume (wget/curl) and verify completeness
ensure_dataset <- function(filename, url) {
  min_size_bytes <- 85 * 1024^2   # full ERSSTv6 file is ~90.1 MB
 
  if (file.exists(filename) && file.size(filename) >= min_size_bytes) {
    message(sprintf("Using verified local file: %s (%.1f MB)",
                    filename, file.size(filename) / 1024^2))
    return(invisible(TRUE))
  }
 
  message(sprintf("Dataset missing or incomplete (<85 MB). Downloading %s from NOAA PSL...",
                  filename))
 
  if (nzchar(Sys.which("wget"))) {
    status <- system2("wget", c("-c", "--tries=10", "--timeout=30",
                                shQuote(url), "-O", shQuote(filename)))
    if (status != 0) stop("wget failed with status ", status)
  } else if (nzchar(Sys.which("curl"))) {
    status <- system2("curl", c("-C", "-", "--retry", "10", "--retry-delay", "3",
                                "-L", "-o", shQuote(filename), shQuote(url)))
    if (status != 0) stop("curl failed with status ", status)
  } else {
    # Fallback: base R downloader with retries (no resume)
    options(timeout = max(600, getOption("timeout")))
    for (attempt in 1:5) {
      ok <- tryCatch({
        download.file(url, filename, mode = "wb", quiet = FALSE)
        TRUE
      }, error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("Attempt %d/5 interrupted (%s). Retrying...",
                        attempt, conditionMessage(e)))
        Sys.sleep(2)
        FALSE
      })
      if (ok) break
    }
  }
 
  if (!file.exists(filename) || file.size(filename) < min_size_bytes) {
    stop("Download incomplete. Please re-run to complete the download.")
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

# 1. Read Data

Pull data from its source: Manual data: data/unformatted data. Automated data: Add script for data call (API, package, etc.). Confidential data: Store locally in the confidential data folder - This folder is excluded using gitignore and will not push to the GitHub repo. If intermediate data (shapefiles etc.) are needed, please put them in data\>intermediate - Filename should use the syntax rootname_descriptivename

```{r}
local_nc_file <- "../../../data/unformatted/sst.mnmean.nc"
file_url <- "https://psl.noaa.gov/thredds/fileServer/Datasets/noaa.ersst.v6/sst.mnmean.nc"
 
ensure_dataset(local_nc_file, file_url)
 
nc  <- nc_open(local_nc_file)
lon <- as.numeric(ncvar_get(nc, "lon"))
lat <- as.numeric(ncvar_get(nc, "lat"))
time_all <- nc_time_to_date(nc, "time")
sst <- ncvar_get(nc, "sst")

# Make sure the array is [lon, lat, time]
dnames <- vapply(nc$var$sst$dim, function(d) d$name, character(1))
sst <- aperm(sst, match(c("lon", "lat", "time"), dnames))
nc_close(nc)
 
# Ensure latitude is ascending
if (lat[1] > lat[length(lat)]) {
  sst <- sst[, rev(seq_along(lat)), , drop = FALSE]
  lat <- rev(lat)
}
 
# Full 1950-2025 record
keep <- time_all >= as.Date("1950-01-01") & time_all <= as.Date("2025-12-31")
sst  <- sst[, , keep, drop = FALSE]
time_sel <- time_all[keep]
 
nlon <- length(lon); nlat <- length(lat); nt <- length(time_sel)
M <- matrix(sst, nrow = nlon * nlat, ncol = nt)   # [cell, time]
rm(sst)
 
cell_lon <- rep(lon, times = nlat)
cell_lat <- rep(lat, each  = nlon)
months   <- as.integer(format(time_sel, "%m"))

# A. Monthly anomalies + 3-month running mean
sst_atl_anom_raw <- roll_time(calc_anomalies(M, months), k = 3)
rm(M)
 
# B. Detrend toggle
DETREND <- FALSE
 
if (DETREND) {
  message("Detrending SST data...")
  sst_atl_anom <- detrend_dim(sst_atl_anom_raw)
} else {
  message("Skipping detrending...")
  sst_atl_anom <- sst_atl_anom_raw
}
rm(sst_atl_anom_raw)
 
# C. North Atlantic domain (0-60N, 280-358E)
sub <- which(cell_lat >= 0 & cell_lat <= 60 & cell_lon >= 280 & cell_lon <= 358)
sub_lat <- cell_lat[sub]
sub_lon <- cell_lon[sub]
 
# Exclude non-Atlantic water bodies inside the bounding box
is_pacific <- sub_lat < 10 & sub_lon <= 284
is_med     <- sub_lat >= 30 & sub_lat <= 46 & sub_lon >= 355
is_hudson  <- sub_lat >= 50 & sub_lon <= 282
 
# Keep only ocean points with continuous records across time
is_valid_ocean <- rowSums(is.na(sst_atl_anom[sub, , drop = FALSE])) == 0
ocean_mask <- is_valid_ocean & !is_pacific & !is_med & !is_hudson
```

# 2. Clean data and create time series csv

Transform the data to fit the IEA data format.
For more info on IEA data format go to the IEAnalyzeR vignette [HERE](https://gulf-iea.github.io/IEAnalyzeR/articles/How_to_use_IEAnalyzeR.html).
Once data are formatted with time (annual or monthly) as column 1 and metric values in the remaining columns, you can use the function convert_cleaned_data to convert your csv into a format that can be read by the data_prep function. Replace "your_data" in the code below with whatever your dataframe is called.

```{r}
# Compute EOFs via SVD (1950-2025 baseline)
message("Computing EOFs via native SVD...")
 
TARGET_MODE <- 2
mode_idx <- TARGET_MODE
 
ocean_cells <- sub[ocean_mask]
X <- t(sst_atl_anom[ocean_cells, , drop = FALSE])   # [time, ocean_cells]
 
# Area weighting by sqrt(cos(latitude))
weights <- sqrt(cos(cell_lat[ocean_cells] * pi / 180))
X_weighted <- X * rep(weights, each = nrow(X))
 
# SVD (note: input is NOT re-centered, as in the Python code)
sv <- svd(X_weighted, nu = min(dim(X_weighted)), nv = 0)
 
# Explained variance and normalized PC (unit standard deviation)
n_t <- nrow(X)
eigenvalues <- sv$d^2 / (n_t - 1)
sst_var <- eigenvalues / sum(eigenvalues) * 100
 
sst_pc <- sv$u[, mode_idx] * sqrt(n_t - 1)
 
# Spatial regression across the full domain -> [lon, lat] matrix
reg_vec <- regress_spatial(sst_pc, time_sel, sst_atl_anom, time_sel)
sst_reg_eof <- matrix(reg_vec, nrow = nlon, ncol = nlat)
 
# --- Automatic polarity check ---
trop_idx <- outer(lon >= 300 & lon <= 340, lat >= 10 & lat <= 20, "&")
trop_atl_mean <- mean(sst_reg_eof[trop_idx], na.rm = TRUE)
 
if (trop_atl_mean < 0) {
  message(sprintf("Tropical Atlantic mean is %.4f (Negative). Flipping EOF%d polarity.",
                  trop_atl_mean, TARGET_MODE))
  sst_pc <- sst_pc * -1
  sst_reg_eof <- sst_reg_eof * -1
} else {
  message(sprintf("Tropical Atlantic mean is %.4f (Positive). Polarity is retained.",
                  trop_atl_mean))
}
 
# --- Cleaning: spatial smoothing & precision Pacific mask ---
# 1. 3x3 smoothing, min 4 valid points
sst_reg_eof <- roll_2d(sst_reg_eof, min_n = 4)
 
# 2. Remove Pacific SST strictly west of the Americas
LON <- matrix(rep(lon, times = nlat), nlon, nlat)
LAT <- matrix(rep(lat, each  = nlon), nlon, nlat)
 
is_pacific_plot <- LON >= 240 & (
  (LAT <= -18 & LON <= 290) |
  (LAT > -18 & LAT <= -4  & LON <= 285) |
  (LAT > -4  & LAT <= 6   & LON <= 282) |
  (LAT > 6   & LAT <= 9   & LON <= 279) |
  (LAT > 9   & LAT <= 15  & LON <= 273) |
  (LAT > 15  & LAT <= 32  & LON <= 260)
)
sst_reg_eof[is_pacific_plot] <- NA

#Plotting Prep MAP

# Lon is converted to -180..180, so add_cyclic_point() isn't needed here
LON180 <- ifelse(LON > 180, LON - 360, LON)
plot_df <- data.frame(
  lon   = as.vector(LON180),
  lat   = as.vector(LAT),
  value = as.vector(sst_reg_eof) * 10
)
plot_df <- plot_df[plot_df$lon >= -105 & plot_df$lon <= 25, ]
 
# contourf(..., extend = "both"): clamp so out-of-range values land in end bins
plot_df$value <- pmin(pmax(plot_df$value, -4.5), 4.5)
 
land <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
 
lon_lab <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x == 0, "0\u00b0", sprintf("%d\u00b0%s", abs(x), ifelse(x < 0, "W", "E")))
}
lat_lab <- function(y) {
  ifelse(y == 0, "0\u00b0", sprintf("%d\u00b0%s", abs(y), ifelse(y < 0, "S", "N")))
}

#Plotting Prep Timeseries
SATELLITE_START <- as.Date("1990-01-01")
x_end <- as.Date("2025-12-31")
pc_df <- data.frame(time = time_sel, pc = sst_pc)
pc_df <- pc_df[pc_df$time >= SATELLITE_START, ]

pc_df$time<-format(pc_df$time, "%Y-%m") #BT changed to year month for data prep function

 
xticks_years <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-01-01", seq(1990, 2025, by = 5)))
```

ggplot() +
  geom_contour_filled(data = plot_df,
                      aes(lon, lat, z = value, fill = after_stat(level_mid)),
                      breaks = seq(-5, 5, 1)) +
  geom_contour(data = plot_df, aes(lon, lat, z = value),
               breaks = seq(-4, 4, 1), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_contour(data = plot_df, aes(lon, lat, z = value),
               breaks = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "gray80", colour = "gray50", linewidth = 0.3) +  # land above contours
  annotate("segment", x = -100, xend = 20, y = 0, yend = 0, colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_stepsn(colours = rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")),
                    breaks = seq(-4, 4, 1), limits = c(-5, 5), name = NULL,
                    guide = guide_coloursteps(even.steps = TRUE, show.limits = FALSE)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-100, 0, 20), labels = lon_lab) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 60, 20),  labels = lat_lab) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-100, 0), ylim = c(0, 60), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "North Atlantic SST Tripole (EOF2)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"))
